# Voxtral Swift MLX

> Native Swift implementation of Mistral's Voxtral models on Apple Silicon with MLX: speech-to-text (Mini 3B, Small 24B), realtime speech-to-text (Mini 4B Realtime) and text-to-speech (TTS 4B) with voice cloning.

**Version:** v2.2.x — latest tag `v2.2.2` = commit `9392ed1` (git tags are the version; `VoxtralCoreVersion` = "0.1.0" in `Sources/VoxtralCore/VoxtralCore.swift:45` and `VoxtralCLI --version` = "2.0.0" in `Sources/VoxtralTranscriptionTest/VoxtralCLI.swift:25` do not follow the tags)
**Repository:** https://github.com/VincentGourbin/mlx-voxtral-swift
**Checked against:** `9392ed1` (v2.2.2), audit of 2026-09-27 (`docs/audit/2026-09-27/`, findings S-19, S-20, FA-02)

## Overview

Voxtral Swift MLX is a native Swift library (`VoxtralCore`) with three pipelines, all running locally on Apple Silicon with MLX and downloading their weights from HuggingFace on first use:

1. **STT** — `VoxtralPipeline` (and the `@MainActor` facade `VoxtralTranscriptionManager`): transcription and chat about an audio file with Voxtral Mini 3B / Small 24B. The audio encoder can run on Core ML (backends `.auto`, `.hybrid`).
2. **Realtime STT** — `VoxtralRealtimePipeline` (and `VoxtralRealtimeManager`): transcription of an audio file with Voxtral Mini 4B Realtime. No live-input streaming API yet.
3. **TTS** — `VoxtralTTSPipeline` (and `VoxtralTTSSynthesisManager`): speech synthesis with Voxtral TTS 4B, 20 voice presets in 9 languages (`TTS/VoxtralVoicePresets.swift:19-45`), batch or chunked streaming, plus voice cloning (`enrollVoice`) and procedural voices (ZeroVoice, preset blending).

## Requirements

- macOS 15.0+ or iOS 17.0+ (`Package.swift:10-13`; iOS compiles but has never been run on a device — audit FA-09)
- Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4)
- Xcode 26+ with the Swift 6.2 toolchain (`swift-tools-version: 6.2`, `Package.swift:1`)
- Build the CLI and apps with `xcodebuild`, not `swift build` (MLX Metal shaders; see `CLAUDE.md`)

## Installation (Swift Package Manager)

```swift
dependencies: [
    // v2.2.2, pinned by revision
    .package(url: "https://github.com/VincentGourbin/mlx-voxtral-swift", revision: "9392ed13c9be8d2e9bc1752cd57817d318f2eb40")
    // or: branch: "main"
]
// target dependency:
.product(name: "VoxtralCore", package: "mlx-voxtral-swift")
```

Depending on v2.2.x: since v2.2.2 the package depends on `mlx-swift-lm` by `branch: "main"` (`Package.swift:52`, reason at `:46-51`). SwiftPM does not let a package required by version depend on a branch, so `from: "2.2.0"` cannot resolve to v2.2.2 (audit FA-02). Until `mlx-swift-lm` tags a release beyond `3.31.4` (its latest tag on 2026-09-27, audit FV-02), depend by `revision:` or `branch: "main"`, and if your package also depends on `mlx-swift-lm`, use `branch: "main"` for it too (a version and a branch requirement on the same package cannot be resolved together, `Package.swift:46-50`).

## Quick Start

### STT

```swift
import VoxtralCore

let pipeline = VoxtralPipeline(model: .mini3b8bit, backend: .auto)
try await pipeline.loadModel { progress, status in print("\(Int(progress * 100))% \(status)") }
let text = try await pipeline.transcribe(audio: audioURL, language: "en")   // language nil = auto-detect
let answer = try await pipeline.chat(audio: audioURL, prompt: "Summarize this", language: "en")
pipeline.unload()
```

### Realtime STT

```swift
let realtime = VoxtralRealtimePipeline()                 // defaults: maxTokens 4096, temperature 0, transcriptionDelayMs 480 (VoxtralRealtimePipeline.swift:32)
try await realtime.loadModel(modelId: "realtime-4b-4bit") // nil = registry default
let text = try await realtime.transcribe(audio: audioURL)
realtime.unload()
```

### TTS

```swift
let tts = VoxtralTTSPipeline()
try await tts.loadModel(modelInfo: VoxtralTTSRegistry.model(withId: "tts-4b-6bit")!)  // nil = default tts-4b-mlx (bf16)
let result = try await tts.synthesize(text: "Hello world!", voice: .neutralFemale, seed: 42)
try WAVWriter.write(waveform: result.waveform, to: outputURL)

for try await chunk in tts.synthesizeStreaming(text: "Long text…", voice: .frFemale, chunkSize: 10) {
    // chunk.waveform, chunk.isFirst, chunk.isFinal, chunk.elapsed
}
tts.unload()
```

### Voice cloning (TTS)

```swift
try tts.enrollVoice(referenceURL: refURL, outputURL: URL(fileURLWithPath: "voice.safetensors"))
let emb = try MLX.loadArrays(url: URL(fileURLWithPath: "voice.safetensors"))["embedding"]!
let cloned = try await tts.synthesize(text: "Any text.", voiceEmbedding: emb)
```

The reference is prepared in this order (`TTS/VoiceCloning/VoxtralVoiceEnrollment.swift:151-162`): 70 Hz high-pass (`Config.referenceHighPassHz`), loudness normalization of active speech to −20 dBFS (`Config.referenceTargetRMSdB`), then a noise gate that attenuates windows 30 dB below the loudest 20 ms window by 24 dB (`Config.gateReference`, `gateThresholdDB`, `gateAttenuationDB`). Settings: `VoxtralVoiceEnrollment.swift:58-89`; guide: `docs/voice_cloning.md`.

## Main APIs

### VoxtralTranscriptionManager (@MainActor facade over VoxtralPipeline)

```swift
VoxtralTranscriptionManager.isDefaultModelDownloaded() -> Bool
VoxtralTranscriptionManager.isModelDownloaded(_ model: VoxtralPipeline.Model) -> Bool
VoxtralTranscriptionManager.downloadDefaultModel(progress:) async throws -> URL
VoxtralTranscriptionManager.deleteDefaultModel() throws

let manager = VoxtralTranscriptionManager()                    // default model mini-3b-8bit, backend .auto
let manager = VoxtralTranscriptionManager(model: .mini3b4bit)
try await manager.loadModel()
let result = try await manager.transcribe(audioURL: URL)       // TranscriptionResult
let response = try await manager.chat(audioURL: URL, prompt: String)
manager.unloadModel()

result.text             // transcribed text
result.duration         // wall-clock seconds of the call
result.tokenCount       // always 0 at v2.2.2 (VoxtralTranscriptionManager.swift:126) — not a metric
result.tokensPerSecond  // tokenCount / duration, so always 0 at v2.2.2 — not a metric
```

### VoxtralPipeline (STT)

```swift
// Models: .mini3b, .mini3b8bit, .mini3b4bit, .small24b, .small24b8bit, .small4bit
// Backends: .mlx (MLX encoder), .hybrid (Core ML encoder + MLX decoder), .auto (Core ML if available, else MLX; the default)
var config = VoxtralPipeline.Configuration.default   // maxTokens 500, temperature 0, topP 0.95, repetitionPenalty 1.2, memoryOptimization .recommended() (VoxtralPipeline.swift:106-122)
config.maxTokens = 2000                              // 500 tokens ≈ 3 min of speech; the rest is not transcribed (docs/audit/2026-09-27/PLAN.md §1)
let pipeline = VoxtralPipeline(model: .mini3b8bit, backend: .auto, configuration: config)
print(pipeline.encoderStatus)
```

### VoxtralTTSPipeline (TTS)

```swift
VoxtralTTSPipeline.Configuration(maxFrames: 2500, temperature: 0, cfgAlpha: 1.2, flowSteps: 8,   // defaults, VoxtralTTSPipeline.swift:46
                                 sanitizeText: true, trimLeadIn: true, trimTail: false)
synthesize(text:voice:seed:) / synthesize(text:voiceEmbedding:seed:warmUpText:warmUpLeadInFrames:)
synthesize(text:voiceCoordinate:)                                   // ZeroVoice
synthesizeStreaming(text:voice:chunkSize:seed:warmUpText:warmUpLeadInFrames:)
enrollVoice(referenceURL:outputURL:config:progress:shouldContinue:)
```

- `flowSteps`, `cfgAlpha` and `temperature` are **not read** by the TTS path at v2.2.2: 8 Euler steps and CFG alpha 1.2 are hard-coded (`TTS/VoxtralFlowMatching.swift:195-196`). The CLI options `--flow-steps`, `--cfg-alpha`, `-t` have no effect either (audit P-35; fiche K-48).
- `synthesizeStreaming` generates every frame before yielding the first chunk at v2.2.2 (synchronous `AsyncThrowingStream` build closure, `TTS/VoxtralTTSModeling.swift:572-688`): the first chunk's `elapsed` ≈ total generation time (audit S-08, FA-04; fiche K-12).
- Without `seed:`, the same text and voice give a different take on every call (flow-matching noise; `VoxtralTTSModeling.swift:440`).
- `TTSSynthesisResult.timeToFirstToken` = time to the first code frame (prefill included), not the first audio sample (`VoxtralTTSModeling.swift:441`, `:496-499`); `realTimeFactor` = generation time ÷ audio duration, < 1 = faster than real time (`VoxtralTTSProcessor.swift:30-33`). Glossary: `docs/Benchmarks.md` §4.
- The codec decoder's weights are bf16 in every pack, but it computes in fp32: the quantizer's embeddings are fp32 and promote every layer (`TTS/VoxtralCodecDecoder.swift:336-341`, `:358-361`, `:83`; audit P-38).

### ModelDownloader / ModelRegistry

```swift
ModelDownloader.customModelsDirectory = myURL          // set once, at startup, before any download
ModelDownloader.modelsDirectory                        // default ~/Library/Caches/models
ModelDownloader.resolveModel(_ identifier: String) async throws -> URL
ModelDownloader.listDownloadedModels() -> [VoxtralModelInfo]
ModelDownloader.deleteModel(_ model: VoxtralModelInfo) throws
ModelDownloader.isDefaultModelDownloaded() / downloadDefaultModel(progress:) / deleteDefaultModel()   // default = ModelRegistry.defaultModel

ModelRegistry.models / defaultModel / model(withId:) / model(withRepoId:) / miniModels / smallModels   // STT
VoxtralTTSRegistry.models / defaultModel / model(withId:)                                           // TTS
VoxtralRealtimeRegistry.models / defaultModel / model(withId:)                                      // Realtime
```

## Available Models

Download = exact bytes of the weight files on the Hub on 2026-09-27, 1 GB = 10⁹ bytes (`docs/Weights.md`). The `size` strings in the registries are approximate.

| Pipeline | ID | Repository | Download (GB) | Precision | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| STT | mini-3b | mistralai/Voxtral-Mini-3B-2507 | 9.36 (+ 9.35 `consolidated.safetensors`, also downloaded at v2.2.2) | bf16 | |
| STT | mini-3b-8bit | mzbac/voxtral-mini-3b-8bit | 5.40 | 8-bit | default |
| STT | mini-3b-4bit | mzbac/voxtral-mini-3b-4bit-mixed | 3.20 | 4-bit mixed | |
| STT | small-24b | mistralai/Voxtral-Small-24B-2507 | 48.53 (+ 48.52 `consolidated.safetensors`) | bf16 | |
| STT | small-24b-8bit | registry: VincentGOURBIN/voxtral-small-8bit · `VoxtralPipeline` enum: mzbac/Voxtral-Small-24B-2507-8bit | 26.50 · 28.06 | 8-bit | two repositories for one id at v2.2.2 |
| STT | small-4bit | VincentGOURBIN/voxtral-small-4bit-mixed | 14.86 | 4-bit mixed | |
| Realtime | realtime-4b-4bit | mlx-community/Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-2602-4bit | 3.13 | 4-bit | default |
| Realtime | realtime-4b-fp16 | mlx-community/Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-2602-fp16 | 8.87 | fp16 | |
| Realtime | realtime-4b | mistralai/Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-2602 | 8.86 (+ 8.86 `model.safetensors`) | bf16 | does not load at v2.2.2 |
| TTS | tts-4b-mlx | mlx-community/Voxtral-4B-TTS-2603-mlx-bf16 | 8.00 | bf16 | default (slowest) |
| TTS | tts-4b | mistralai/Voxtral-4B-TTS-2603 | 8.00 | bf16 | original checkpoint |
| TTS | tts-4b-4bit | mlx-community/Voxtral-4B-TTS-2603-mlx-4bit | 2.51 | 4-bit | |
| TTS | tts-4b-6bit | mlx-community/Voxtral-4B-TTS-2603-mlx-6bit | 3.47 | 6-bit | |

Backends `.auto` / `.hybrid` also download the Core ML encoder: VincentGOURBIN/voxtral-encoder-coreml-mini (1.32 GB) or -small (1.38 GB), under `~/Library/Caches/models/VincentGOURBIN/`. Licences (`docs/Weights.md`): TTS weights CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial); STT and Realtime weights Apache-2.0 (Hub tag, or the base model's licence for untagged packs). Sources of the notes: `consolidated.safetensors` audit S-07, `small-24b-8bit` audit S-06 (`VoxtralPipeline.swift:47-48` vs `ModelRegistry.swift:89-97`), `realtime-4b` audit M-01, TTS default audit FA-03 (`VoxtralTTSRegistry.swift:29-37`).

## Key Types

- `VoxtralTranscriptionManager` — high-level STT API (@MainActor)
- `VoxtralPipeline` — STT pipeline (`@unchecked Sendable`); `.Model`, `.Backend`, `.Configuration`, `.State` (.unloaded, .loading, .ready, .processing, .error(String))
- `VoxtralRealtimePipeline`, `VoxtralRealtimeManager`, `VoxtralRealtimeRegistry`, `VoxtralRealtimeModelInfo` — Realtime STT
- `VoxtralTTSPipeline`, `VoxtralTTSSynthesisManager`, `VoxtralTTSRegistry`, `VoxtralTTSModelInfo`, `VoxtralVoice` (20 presets), `TTSSynthesisResult`, `WAVWriter` — TTS
- `VoxtralVoiceEnrollment` (`.Config`, `.Progress`) — voice cloning
- `TranscriptionResult` — text, duration (tokenCount / tokensPerSecond are always 0 at v2.2.2)
- `VoxtralModelInfo`, `ModelRegistry`, `ModelDownloader` — STT model catalog and downloads
- `MemoryOptimizationConfig` — presets `.disabled`, `.light`, `.moderate`, `.aggressive`, `.ultra`, `.recommended(forRAMGB:)`
- `VoxtralMemoryManager` — process-wide memory settings (singleton `.shared`)
- `VoxtralPipelineError` (invalidState, modelNotLoaded, processingFailed, transcriptionFailed), `VoxtralTranscriptionError` (modelNotLoaded, audioRequired, transcriptionFailed)
- `RuntimeBeacon` — opt-in activity manifest for external monitors (`RuntimeBeacon.isEnabled = true`)

## Memory Optimization

```swift
MemoryOptimizationConfig.recommended()   // by RAM: <16 GB .ultra, 16-31 .aggressive, 32-63 .moderate, ≥64 .light (MemoryOptimizationConfig.swift:77-90)
MemoryOptimizationConfig.disabled        // no eval/cache management, no KV cache limit

// Custom (the actual fields)
let memory = MemoryOptimizationConfig(
    evalFrequency: 8,        // eval() every N tokens (0 = disabled)
    clearCacheOnEval: false,
    resetPeakMemory: true,
    maxKVCacheSize: nil      // nil = unlimited KV cache
)
```

Presets `.light` / `.moderate` / `.aggressive` / `.ultra` set `maxKVCacheSize` 8192 / 6144 / 4096 / 2048 (`Configuration/MemoryOptimizationConfig.swift:41-69`).

## Concurrency (v2.2.2)

- Use one pipeline instance for one operation at a time. `VoxtralPipeline`, `VoxtralTTSPipeline` and `VoxtralRealtimePipeline` are `@unchecked Sendable` with unguarded state: two concurrent `loadModel` calls, or `unload()` during a stream, are not protected (audit S-10; fiche K-11).
- Never run `enrollVoice` concurrently with a synthesis or a load: enrollment does not mark the pipeline busy (`TTS/Pipeline/VoxtralTTSPipeline.swift:425-452`), and a gradient computation concurrent with inference can deadlock mlx-swift 0.31.6 (`Package.swift:43`; audit A-01; fiche K-11).
- `ModelDownloader` is **not** thread-safe: `customModelsDirectory` and the lazily created Hub client are unguarded statics (`Utils/ModelDownloader.swift:28`, `:32-39`; audit S-11). Set `customModelsDirectory` once at startup.
- Each `VoxtralPipeline.init` writes the process-wide `VoxtralMemoryManager.shared.config` (`Pipeline/VoxtralPipeline.swift:204`): two STT pipelines with different memory configurations overwrite each other (audit S-11; fiche K-16).

## CLI Usage

The executable is `VoxtralCLI` (`xcodebuild -scheme VoxtralCLI -configuration Release -derivedDataPath .build/xcode -destination 'platform=macOS' build` → `.build/xcode/Build/Products/Release/VoxtralCLI`); `voxtral` in its help text is only the command name.

```bash
./VoxtralCLI list                                   # models and download status
./VoxtralCLI download mini-3b-8bit                  # any registry id (STT, Realtime, TTS)
./VoxtralCLI transcribe audio.mp3 --model mini-3b-8bit --language en
./VoxtralCLI transcribe audio.mp3 --backend hybrid  # CLI backends: mlx (default) or hybrid; no auto mode (VoxtralCLI.swift:187, :210)
./VoxtralCLI chat audio.mp3 "Summarize this audio"
./VoxtralCLI realtime audio.mp3 --model realtime-4b-4bit
./VoxtralCLI tts "Bonjour !" -o out.wav --model tts-4b-6bit --voice fr_female --seed 42
./VoxtralCLI enroll ref.wav -o voice.safetensors --model tts-4b --duration 16
./VoxtralCLI tts "Hello." -o out.wav --model tts-4b --voice-embedding voice.safetensors --seed 7 --warm-up
./VoxtralCLI profile …                              # profiling; its "RT factor" is audio ÷ generation, the inverse of RTF (ProfileCommand.swift:274)
```

## Source Files

- `Sources/VoxtralCore/Pipeline/VoxtralPipeline.swift`, `VoxtralTranscriptionManager.swift` — STT API
- `Sources/VoxtralCore/Realtime/` (`Pipeline/VoxtralRealtimePipeline.swift`, `VoxtralRealtimeRegistry.swift`) — Realtime STT
- `Sources/VoxtralCore/TTS/` (`Pipeline/VoxtralTTSPipeline.swift`, `VoxtralTTSRegistry.swift`, `VoxtralTTSModeling.swift`, `VoxtralFlowMatching.swift`, `VoxtralCodecDecoder.swift`, `VoxtralZeroVoice.swift`) — TTS
- `Sources/VoxtralCore/TTS/VoiceCloning/VoxtralVoiceEnrollment.swift` — voice cloning
- `Sources/VoxtralCore/CoreML/` — Core ML encoder (hybrid backend)
- `Sources/VoxtralCore/Utils/ModelDownloader.swift`, `ModelRegistry.swift` — downloads and STT catalog
- `Sources/VoxtralCore/Configuration/MemoryOptimizationConfig.swift` — memory presets
- `Sources/VoxtralCore/VoxtralModeling.swift`, `VoxtralProcessor.swift`, `Models/VoxtralLlama.swift` — STT model
- `Sources/VoxtralTranscriptionTest/VoxtralCLI.swift` — CLI

## Important: API Usage Guidelines

### Supported APIs (use these)

| API | Use Case | Concurrency |
|-----|----------|---------------|
| `VoxtralTranscriptionManager` | Simple transcription/chat | @MainActor |
| `VoxtralPipeline` | STT with model, backend and configuration choice | one operation at a time per instance |
| `VoxtralRealtimePipeline` | Realtime STT of a file | one operation at a time per instance |
| `VoxtralTTSPipeline` | TTS, streaming, voice cloning | one operation at a time; never enroll during synthesis |
| `ModelDownloader` | Model download/management | not thread-safe (see Concurrency) |
| `ModelRegistry`, `VoxtralTTSRegistry`, `VoxtralRealtimeRegistry` | Model discovery | immutable catalogs (`static let`) |

### Do NOT access directly

- `VoxtralForConditionalGeneration` - Internal model class
- `loadVoxtralModel()` - Internal loading function
- Model weight keys (e.g., `language_model.embed_tokens.weight`)
- Direct parameter access via `model.parameters()`

**Why?** The internal weight loading uses key transformations (snake_case → camelCase)
that are not exposed in the public API.

- `README.md` — overview, models, published benchmarks (all "in session": not references)
- `docs/voice_cloning.md`, `docs/streaming_demo.md`, `docs/tts_benchmark.md`, `docs/zerovoice_benchmark.md`
- `docs/Weights.md` — exact download sizes, licences, loadability per repository
- `docs/References.md` — reference configurations (skeleton, to measure)
- `docs/Benchmarks.md` — measurement protocol and metric glossary (RTF = generation ÷ audio; TTFT-frame ≠ TTFA)
- `CLAUDE.md` — build, test and measurement rules for coding agents
- `docs/audit/2026-09-27/` — audit of v2.2.2 and action plan (sources of the v2.2.2 caveats above)
